steps.title: Know your traffic
steps.body: Type `enable`, then `more flash:traffic-survey.txt`. Match each flow to the right marking: `submit VOICE=...`, `submit VIDEO=...`, `submit BULK=...`.

steps.title: Build the classes and the policy
steps.body: In `conf t`: `class-map match-any VOICE`, `match protocol rtp audio`, `exit`; `class-map match-any VIDEO`, `match protocol rtp video`, `exit`. Then `policy-map MARK`, `class VOICE`, `set dscp ef`, `exit`, `class VIDEO`, `set dscp af41`, `exit`, `exit`.

objectives.label: policy MARK sets VOICE to EF
policy MARK sets VIDEO to AF41

steps.title: Apply it at the trust boundary
steps.body: Crew traffic enters Northwatch on Gi0/1, so mark it there, inbound: `interface g0/1`, `service-policy input MARK`. `end`, then `show policy-map interface g0/1` to watch the counters.

objectives.label: Saw voice and video being marked
